features.feature: Common annotation placement, appearance eligibility, and F flags
features.source_location: physical 480 / printed 465 (§12.5.1); physical 482–491 / printed 467–476 (Tables 166–167); physical 486 / printed 471 (Table 167 flags)
features.source_rule: §12.5.1 supplies the general annotation/activation context. Table 166 makes AP generally required for writers, except zero-area rectangles and Popup, Projection, or Link; Table 167 makes Hidden suppress rendering/interactions, Print control print output, NoView suppress screen display/interactions, and ReadOnly suppress interaction while allowing rendering/printing subject to other flags.
features.ledger: 12.5.1 implemented; 12.5.2 and 12.5.3 are the common implementation rows
implementation_and_assertions: crates/pdf-model/src/annotation.rs::decide and displayed; crates/pdf-model/src/content/annotations.rs::draw_annotation
crates/pdf-model/tests/annotations.rs::the_hidden_and_no_view_flags_draw_nothing_and_report_nothing asserts F=2,32,34 produce no page commands and no unsupported report
crates/viewer-core/tests/screen_annotation_audit.rs tests stored AP under both Purpose::View and Purpose::Print and selected states
features.boundary: The table's AP obligation is addressed to PDF writers. Reader behavior for a missing AP follows each subtype's clause and selected policy; do not convert a producer violation into mandatory rejection.

features.boundary: Table 186's Parent override names Contents, M, C, and T; F is not inherited. Absence of AP and page ink is the required subtype behavior, not a missing appearance defect.

features.feature: PrinterMark stored AP selection, display and print flags
features.source_location: physical 516 / printed 501 (§12.5.6.20); physical 834 / printed 819 (§14.11.3 appearance/flag requirements and Table 398)
features.source_rule: The annotation clause defines the graphic-symbol purpose and points to §14.11.3. §14.11.3 requires AP and F; Print and ReadOnly set, all other F flags clear; AS is required if AP/N has alternatives. The N form appearance is the mark; R and D appearances are never displayed or printed.
features.ledger: 12.5.6.20 implemented; §14.11.3 implemented; ADR 0205 corrects the prior unsupported claim that a screen cannot display printer marks
implementation_and_assertions: crates/pdf-model/src/annotation.rs selects stored normal appearance and flags through common annotation logic

crates/viewer-core/tests/screen_annotation_audit.rs::printer_mark_and_legacy_trapnet_render_their_stored_appearance_for_view_and_print uses F=68 (Print+ReadOnly, with NoView clear) and asserts the red AP pixel for View and Print

crates/viewer-core/tests/screen_annotation_audit.rs::printer_mark_and_trapnet_as_select_the_named_normal_appearance uses distinct red/blue normal appearances, asserts /AS changes the sampled pixel under View and Print
features.boundary: The visual/AP and flag clauses constrain authoring; the renderer's stored AP behavior is tested with a conforming flag combination. /MN and Colorants are descriptive/prepress fields, not display obligations.

features.feature: TrapNet stored AP selection/order, print and display; deprecated-feature boundary
features.source_location: physical 516 / printed 501 (§12.5.6.21); physical 841 / printed 826 (§14.11.6.2 prose); physical 842 / printed 827 (Table 403 and LastModified condition)
features.source_rule: PDF 2.0 deprecates trapping. The annotation clause's max-one and last-in-Annots rules describe conforming files; the last position naturally composites after preceding annotations. §14.11.6.2 requires AP, AS, F, Print+ReadOnly, all other flags clear; named /N selection controls current network. R/D are never printed. Table 403 provides change-tracking entries.
features.ledger: 12.5.6.21 implemented; §14.11.6.2 implemented; ADRs 0906, 1035, 1535, 0205 are directly relevant
implementation_and_assertions: crates/pdf-model/src/annotation.rs uses common AP selection/placement; crates/pdf-model/src/content/annotations.rs follows /Annots order
crates/viewer-core/tests/screen_annotation_audit.rs uses a named /N state plus /AS and asserts red in View and Print

crates/pdf-model/tests/annotations.rs::every_annotation_type_table_171_defines_is_answered_by_its_own_clause checks handler membership, not TrapNet's visual semantics; it is not counted as the behavioral test
features.boundary: The legacy compatibility reader draws the stored AP; it does not generate traps. The at-most-one/last requirement is a file-structure rule; reader reordering/rejection is not stated.

features.feature: Watermark AP, FixedPrint geometry/media, no popup or interaction, and shared F flags
features.source_location: physical 516 / printed 501 (clause and Table 193); physical 517 / printed 502 (Table 194 and rendering algorithm)
features.source_rule: FixedPrint optional; absent means ordinary annotation placement; present requires the Table 194 rendering transform. On-screen media dimensions shall use MediaBox. Watermarks shall have no popup or other interactive elements. Table 194 defaults Matrix to identity and H,V to zero.
implementation_and_assertions: crates/pdf-model/src/annotation.rs::fixed_print and is_watermark/interacts; crates/pdf-model/src/popup.rs::popups

crates/pdf-model/tests/annotations.rs::a_fixed_print_watermark_is_placed_against_the_media and a_watermark_is_not_under_the_pointer_and_a_square_is
crates/pdf-model/src/popup.rs::a_watermark_has_no_popup_window_and_a_square_has_one
crates/viewer-core/tests/printing.rs tests NoView+Print and fixed-print output; prior print_intent and watermark_nup_consumer audits cover media/print consumers
features.errata: No relevant EC3 change located for this clause in doc/errata-read.md.
features.boundary: Public two-up/four-up watermark placement is now confirmed by watermark_nup_consumer_audit and broad123. No tiling selection/native printer certification; page Rotate interpretation remains qualified.

features.feature: Projection is a runtime-context measurement subtype; AP exception/Errata #94
features.source_location: physical 520 / printed 505; EC3 issue #42 strikes the final paragraph here and issue #94 annotates the runtime-context sentence
features.source_rule: EC3 Issue #42 strikes the entire final paragraph of §12.5.6.24, including the zero-width/height Rect sentence. Table 166 separately exempts Projection from the general AP-writer requirement. The EC3 #94 overlay adds that the annotation is only valid in its associated runtime and '*and thus an AP dictionary is not required*'; the AP-less behavior is consistent with the surviving AP exception.
features.ledger: implemented; ADR 0901, ADR 0906, and the #94 entry in doc/errata-read.md are relevant
implementation_and_assertions: crates/pdf-model/src/annotation.rs::decided handles stored AP before construct; construct returns Nothing for AP-less Projection
crates/pdf-model/tests/annotations.rs::no_table_171_subtype_is_refused_with_the_catch_all_s_sentence includes Projection in the no-AP handler population
crates/pdf-model/tests/annotations.rs::the_hidden_and_no_view_flags_draw_nothing_and_report_nothing only asserts generic Square flags; it does not itself prove Projection behavior
features.boundary: The associated 3D runtime and measurement interaction are outside this shard and the scope's clause-13 exclusion. No valid runtime fixture was found here, so no AP-present Projection assertion is proposed.
